test_dtype_inference_from_string: test the dtype_from_database_typename function that maps database type names like varchar, int4, timestamp to polars dtypes
test_dtype_inference_from_invalid_string: test the dtype_from_database_typename function raises ValueError for unrecognized type names like FooType or Unknown
test_dtype_inference_raise_unmatched_fal: test the dtype_from_database_typename function returns None when raise_unmatched is set to False for invalid type names
test_infer_schema_length: test the pl.read_database function with infer_schema_length parameter to control how many rows are scanned for schema inference
test_infer_schema_length_mismatch_error: test the pl.read_database function raises ComputeError when a row value type mismatches the inferred schema
